title: JEDM
summary: A Python package (published as `jedm` on PyPI) providing standard metrics for evaluating synthetic tabular data, comparing quality and utility across generation methods. It calls SDV's evaluate_quality function and SingleTableMetadata schema to compute quality scores for synthetic datasets.
